purpose: Determine whether the historical shared-alpha upper boundary limits Elastic Net, using certified inner fits.
scope: Upper-grid development sensitivity, not full recertification of smaller historical alphas or a new independent test.
selection: Mean inner heldout-lineage NDCG@10; exact ties prefer larger alpha. Reuse historical folds and seeds.
primary_targets: Same 911 non-common-essential genes within 1204 shared targets.
solver: CUDA float64 certified working-set proximal gradient on historical float32-centered designs; every target must pass full-feature KKT and strong-convexity objective-gap bound, including excluded working-set features.
external_gate: Only consider another Sanger refit if internal lineage-equal NDCG gain over certified fixed-alpha has positive 95% interval; otherwise report internal sensitivity and stop.
test_rule: No TCGA KIRC Locked Test access. Outer labels used only for scoring after inner selection; do not change grid after viewing outer results.
failure_rule: Fail closed if any full-feature certificate fails; checkpoint completed folds with input/protocol/script hashes for exact resume.
